The '''bauhin flower''' was a plant that grew on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. This plant was very common on the banks of Corellian rivers.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The plant was also cultured in the atrium of [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:TPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
